topic: What $1,000 in Bitcoin in 2010 would be worth today -- and the guy who spent 10,000 of them on two pizzas
title: The $700 Million Pizza Order
description:
In 2010, Laszlo Hanyecz paid 10,000 bitcoin for two pizzas -- about $41 at the time. Those coins never moved again, and at today's price they're worth well over $700 million.

#bitcoin #crypto #personalfinance #investing #bitcoinpizzaday
